QuestInfo.name: [Identisk] What Caused the Blessing's Disappearance?
QuestInfo.0:
The shaman of Tisk Island, #bToong#k, is enraged because someone stole the Wind Blessing. 
Talk to Toong.
QuestInfo.1:
Toong suspects the Seekers from Grandis are responsible for the Wind Blessing's disappearance.
Go and talk to #bBaz#k again.
QuestInfo.2: Baz wanted you to investigate the disappearance of the ancient god's blessing from Tisk Island.

npc.0: #bBaz#k is the Seeker you should talk to. Go to Baz.
